summary: Datadog filed an 8-K reporting shareholder approval and completion of a redomiciliation from Delaware to Nevada via a plan of conversion, effective April 21, 2026. The reorganization did not change business, management, assets, or stock terms. No price, premium, or deal value is involved. New indemnification agreements were entered with officers and directors. This is a jurisdictional reincorporation, not a special-situation transaction, so the filing is classified as Other.
